bible_quanes.question: Which king's spirit did the LORD stir up at the start of Ezra?
bible_quanes.answer: Cyrus king of Persia
bible_quanes.explanation: He made a proclamation throughout his kingdom.

bible_quanes.question: What did Cyrus say God had commanded him to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Build Him a house at Jerusalem

bible_quanes.question: Which tribes' leaders rose up to go and rebuild?
bible_quanes.answer: Judah and Benjamin

bible_quanes.question: What did Cyrus bring out and return?
bible_quanes.answer: The vessels of the house of the LORD

bible_quanes.question: Whose prophecy was fulfilled by Cyrus's proclamation?
bible_quanes.answer: Jeremiah
bible_quanes.explanation: In the first year of Cyrus.

bible_quanes.question: What were neighbours to give those returning?
bible_quanes.answer: Silver, gold, goods and beasts, beside the freewill offering

bible_quanes.question: Who counted out the temple articles?
bible_quanes.answer: Mithredath the treasurer

bible_quanes.question: Who was the prince of Judah who received the articles?
bible_quanes.answer: Sheshbazzar

bible_quanes.question: How many gold and silver articles were returned in total?
bible_quanes.answer: Five thousand and four hundred

bible_quanes.question: How many gold platters were returned?
bible_quanes.answer: Thirty

bible_quanes.question: What does Ezra 2 list?
bible_quanes.answer: The children of the province that went up out of the captivity

bible_quanes.question: Who led the first return?
bible_quanes.answer: Zerubbabel; with him Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah
bible_quanes.explanation: Named at the head of the list.

bible_quanes.question: How large was the whole assembly that returned?
bible_quanes.answer: Forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore

bible_quanes.question: What did some heads of families give on arrival?
bible_quanes.answer: They offered freely for the house of God
bible_quanes.explanation: To rebuild it on its site.

bible_quanes.question: Who could not find their genealogical records?
bible_quanes.answer: These sought their register among those reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found
bible_quanes.explanation: They were excluded from the priesthood.

bible_quanes.question: Until when were they excluded from eating holy things?
bible_quanes.answer: Till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim

bible_quanes.question: How many male and female servants returned?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven

bible_quanes.question: How much gold was given for the work?
bible_quanes.answer: Threescore and one thousand drams of gold

bible_quanes.question: How many singers of the sons of Asaph returned?
bible_quanes.answer: An hundred twenty and eight

bible_quanes.question: How many horses returned with the exiles?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven hundred thirty and six

bible_quanes.question: What did the returned exiles build first?
bible_quanes.answer: The altar of the God of Israel

bible_quanes.question: Which feast did they keep?
bible_quanes.answer: The Feast of Tabernacles

bible_quanes.question: What did they sing when the foundation was laid?
bible_quanes.answer: "Because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel"

bible_quanes.question: Who wept when they saw the foundation?
bible_quanes.answer: Ancient men who had seen the first house

bible_quanes.question: Why did they build the altar despite fear?
bible_quanes.answer: Fear was upon them because of the people of those countries
bible_quanes.explanation: They set it on its bases.

bible_quanes.question: What did they bring from Lebanon?
bible_quanes.answer: Cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa

bible_quanes.question: When did the work on the temple begin?
bible_quanes.answer: In the second month of the second year of their coming

bible_quanes.question: Why could the people not tell the shouting from the weeping?
bible_quanes.answer: They could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of weeping
bible_quanes.explanation: The noise was heard far away.

bible_quanes.question: From what age were Levites appointed to oversee the work?
bible_quanes.answer: From twenty years old and upward
bible_quanes.explanation: To oversee the house of the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: With what instruments did the priests praise?
bible_quanes.answer: Trumpets and cymbals

bible_quanes.question: Who offered to help build the temple?
bible_quanes.answer: The adversaries of Judah and Benjamin
bible_quanes.explanation: They claimed to seek God too.

bible_quanes.question: How did Zerubbabel respond?
bible_quanes.answer: "You may do nothing with us to build a house for our God"

bible_quanes.question: What did the people of the land do?
bible_quanes.answer: Weakened the hands of the people of Judah and troubled them in building

bible_quanes.question: What happened to the work on the temple?
bible_quanes.answer: It ceased
bible_quanes.explanation: Until the second year of Darius.

bible_quanes.question: What did the opponents hire?
bible_quanes.answer: Counsellors to frustrate their purpose

bible_quanes.question: In what language was the letter to Artaxerxes written?
bible_quanes.answer: The Syrian tongue

bible_quanes.question: How was Jerusalem described in the accusing letter?
bible_quanes.answer: The rebellious and the bad city
bible_quanes.explanation: To turn the king against them.

bible_quanes.question: What did Artaxerxes order?
bible_quanes.answer: That these men cease and the city be not builded until another commandment

bible_quanes.question: Who wrote the letter against Jerusalem?
bible_quanes.answer: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe

bible_quanes.question: Until which year was the work stopped?
bible_quanes.answer: The second year of Darius king of Persia

bible_quanes.question: Which prophets prophesied to the Jews?
bible_quanes.answer: Haggai and Zechariah
bible_quanes.explanation: In the name of the God of Israel.

bible_quanes.question: Who began to rebuild the house of God?
bible_quanes.answer: Zerubbabel and Jeshua

bible_quanes.question: What was upon the elders of the Jews?
bible_quanes.answer: The eye of their God
bible_quanes.explanation: So the work was not stopped.

bible_quanes.question: How did the elders describe themselves?
bible_quanes.answer: Servants of the God of heaven and earth

bible_quanes.question: Which governor questioned the rebuilding?
bible_quanes.answer: Tatnai

bible_quanes.question: Why did the elders say the first temple was destroyed?
bible_quanes.answer: Their fathers provoked the God of heaven
bible_quanes.explanation: He gave them into Nebuchadnezzar's hand.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Cyrus make governor?
bible_quanes.answer: Sheshbazzar

bible_quanes.question: What did Tatnai ask Darius to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Search the king's treasure house at Babylon for the decree of Cyrus

bible_quanes.question: Who came with Tatnai?
bible_quanes.answer: Shetharboznai

bible_quanes.question: How was the temple being built?
bible_quanes.answer: With great stones, and timber laid in the walls

bible_quanes.question: Where was Cyrus's decree found?
bible_quanes.answer: At Achmetha, in the palace in the province of the Medes

bible_quanes.question: How did the elders prosper in building?
bible_quanes.answer: Through the prophesying of Haggai and Zechariah

bible_quanes.question: When was the temple finished?
bible_quanes.answer: On the third day of Adar, in the sixth year of Darius

bible_quanes.question: Which feast did the returned exiles keep after the dedication?
bible_quanes.answer: The Passover
bible_quanes.explanation: On the fourteenth day of the first month.

bible_quanes.question: What dimensions did Cyrus's decree give for the temple?
bible_quanes.answer: The height threescore cubits, and the breadth threescore cubits

bible_quanes.question: Who paid the expenses of the rebuilding?
bible_quanes.answer: The king's goods, even the tribute beyond the river

bible_quanes.question: What was the penalty for altering Darius's decree?
bible_quanes.answer: Timber pulled down from his house, he hanged thereon, and his house made a dunghill

bible_quanes.question: How did the people celebrate the dedication?
bible_quanes.answer: With joy

bible_quanes.question: What sin offering was made at the dedication?
bible_quanes.answer: Twelve he goats
bible_quanes.explanation: One for each tribe of Israel.

bible_quanes.question: Whose heart did the LORD turn toward the Jews?
bible_quanes.answer: The king of Assyria

bible_quanes.question: How is Ezra described?
bible_quanes.answer: A ready scribe in the law of Moses

bible_quanes.question: What had Ezra prepared his heart to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Seek the Law of the LORD, do it and teach it in Israel

bible_quanes.question: Why did the king grant Ezra all his request?
bible_quanes.answer: The hand of the LORD his God was upon him

bible_quanes.question: Which king gave Ezra a letter of authority?
bible_quanes.answer: Artaxerxes

bible_quanes.question: To which famous priest is Ezra's line traced?
bible_quanes.answer: Aaron the chief priest

bible_quanes.question: How long did Ezra's journey from Babylon take?
bible_quanes.answer: From the first day of the first month to the first day of the fifth month
bible_quanes.explanation: From the first to the fifth month.

bible_quanes.question: Whom was Ezra to appoint?
bible_quanes.answer: Magistrates and judges

bible_quanes.question: What did Ezra praise God for?
bible_quanes.answer: He hath put such a thing in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the LORD

bible_quanes.question: Up to how much silver could Ezra request?
bible_quanes.answer: One hundred talents
bible_quanes.explanation: Along with wheat, wine and oil.

bible_quanes.question: Who was exempt from taxes under the decree?
bible_quanes.answer: Priests, Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims and ministers of the house of God
bible_quanes.explanation: No tribute was imposed on them.

bible_quanes.question: What did Ezra proclaim by the river Ahava?
bible_quanes.answer: A fast

bible_quanes.question: Why did Ezra not ask the king for soldiers?
bible_quanes.answer: He was ashamed, because we had spoken unto the king, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him

bible_quanes.question: What happened on the journey?
bible_quanes.answer: He delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way

bible_quanes.question: What did the returning exiles offer when they arrived?
bible_quanes.answer: Burnt offerings to the God of Israel

bible_quanes.question: Who was missing among those gathered?
bible_quanes.answer: The sons of Levi

bible_quanes.question: Did God answer their prayer and fasting?
bible_quanes.answer: Yes; He was intreated of them

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Ezra entrust with the treasures?
bible_quanes.answer: Twelve of the chief of the priests

bible_quanes.question: How much silver did Ezra weigh out?
bible_quanes.answer: Six hundred and fifty talents
bible_quanes.explanation: And a hundred talents of gold.

bible_quanes.question: What was the name of the river where they camped?
bible_quanes.answer: Ahava

bible_quanes.question: Which man of understanding was found to join them?
bible_quanes.answer: Sherebiah

bible_quanes.question: What did the leaders report to Ezra?
bible_quanes.answer: The people had not separated themselves from the people of the lands

bible_quanes.question: What did Ezra do when he heard?
bible_quanes.answer: Rent his garment and mantle, plucked off his hair and sat down astonied

bible_quanes.question: How did Ezra begin his prayer?
bible_quanes.answer: "O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee"

bible_quanes.question: What did Ezra confess about God?
bible_quanes.answer: He is righteous

bible_quanes.question: Who had led the way in this trespass?
bible_quanes.answer: The princes and rulers

bible_quanes.question: When did Ezra pray?
bible_quanes.answer: At the evening sacrifice

bible_quanes.question: What did God give the remnant in His holy place?
bible_quanes.answer: A nail in His holy place

bible_quanes.question: What had God given them even in bondage?
bible_quanes.answer: A wall in Judah and Jerusalem

bible_quanes.question: How did Ezra describe God's punishment?
bible_quanes.answer: Less than our iniquities deserve

bible_quanes.question: What did Ezra say God had done to their eyes?
bible_quanes.answer: That our God may lighten our eyes

bible_quanes.question: What did the people do as Ezra prayed and wept?
bible_quanes.answer: The people wept very sore

bible_quanes.question: What covenant did Shechaniah propose?
bible_quanes.answer: To put away all the wives and such as were born of them

bible_quanes.question: When did the men of Judah and Benjamin assemble?
bible_quanes.answer: On the twentieth day of the ninth month

bible_quanes.question: What did Ezra tell the people to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Make confession unto the LORD and separate from the people of the land and the strange wives

bible_quanes.question: Who spoke up with hope for Israel?
bible_quanes.answer: Shechaniah the son of Jehiel

bible_quanes.question: What was the penalty for not coming within three days?
bible_quanes.answer: All his substance forfeited and himself separated from the congregation

bible_quanes.question: Why could the matter not be settled at once?
bible_quanes.answer: The people were many and it was a time of much rain

bible_quanes.question: How long did the investigation take?
bible_quanes.answer: From the first day of the tenth month to the first day of the first month

bible_quanes.question: Who opposed the plan?
bible_quanes.answer: Jonathan and Jahaziah

bible_quanes.question: Which priestly family is listed first among those who had married foreign wives?
bible_quanes.answer: The sons of Jeshua
bible_quanes.explanation: They pledged to put them away.
